question: Ruler of which dynasty built the Kandariya Mahadeva temple in 999?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandela.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **ruler of the Chandela dynasty **built the **Kandariya Mahadeva temple** in **999 AD.**
 
• The temple is located in **Khajuraho, Madhya Pradesh** and is one of the finest examples of medieval Indian architecture.
 
• The** Chandela dynasty** ruled over a large part of central India between the **9th and 13th centuries.**
 
• The temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva and is famous for its intricate carvings and sculptures.
 
• The temple complex consists of several **smaller temples** and is a **UNESCO World Heritage site.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sunga dynasty** ruled over parts of northern and central India from the **2nd century BC** to the **1st century AD.**

 
 
• They were known for their contributions to** Buddhism and the arts.**
 
 
 
• **The Nanda dynasty** was an ancient Indian dynasty that ruled over the **Magadha region **in the **4th century BC**.
 
 
• They were known for their **military prowess and wealth.**
 
 
 
• **The Gupta dynasty** was one of the most powerful empires in **ancient India, **ruling over much of northern and central India from the **4th to the 6th century AD.**
 
 
• They were known for their contributions to** literature, art, and science.**
